Уиннизепу: A story from life comes to mind. I was young, still living with my parents, studying at the institute. And it so happened that I was persuaded to tutor the neighbor girl, a schoolgirl, in math. I was supposedly pretty good at that subject back then. To understand the matter, the age difference is important: I'm 20, she's 15.
Fall. Evening. Daddy's making sauces, asked me to grind horseradish: you take frozen peeled horseradish, grind it in the meat grinder, and then it's a matter of taste and imagination.
Примечание - there were no phones then, let alone cell phones - most people didn't even have landlines. So we arranged with the girl in advance - she'd come that day at the appointed time. There were no gates or fences then either.
A knock on the door. I open it. "Hi, what are you up to". - "Oh, just grinding my horseradish". She blushed, got flustered, - "Well okay, I'll come later". Only when the girl reached the gate did it dawn on me - what she heard and thought. I laughed my ass off, caught up, brought her back, demonstrated the process.
Амораль: ladies, don't take everything personally :)
